caption: The drawing depicts an open book cover with intricate designs on both sides. The entire artwork uses a range of brown tones, giving the appearance of carved or embossed leather. The left side of the cover features a large circular motif filled with swirling, interlaced lines and scrollwork, with additional smaller flourishes in each corner. The right side displays a more geometric design with interlocking lines forming strong angular shapes around a central hexagon, which encloses an emblem consisting of stylized, symmetric curves. The panels are bordered with straight lines, and the background is a plain, lighter beige. The central spine of the book is also illustrated, joining the two sides, and the shading throughout indicates texture and depth in the ornately patterned surfaces.
title: Hand-carved Walnut Book Covers
